## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Direction: navigation entries match on word prefixes or contiguous substrings

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:36Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` (the filter for the Objects and Pages groups) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`); paths re-read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`.

- **Why p3:** nonsense queries still return entries; record results are right.
- **Direction:**
  - prefix or substring scoring, with a minimum score, for navigation entries
  - record search is unchanged
  - Not a defect: `?palette=1` is the palette's designed deep link (`CommandPalette.tsx:76`, ADR-0054 C1/C3)
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

ACCEPT — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-08T04:24Z. PR objectui#11883, head `a76ebb5`.

- **PR shape:** draft against `main`, branched from `5d69133`, no rebase. `git merge-tree` of the current `main` (`3035948`) and this head is clean; the queue tests that merge. First line `Fixes #11812`, no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: no` at line start. Both commits carry only the model-free trailer pair. Assigned to `os-support-ai`.
- **Scope:** 5 files, +491/−42, on the claim's surface (`6051110257`):
  - `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`;
  - one new module-private matcher, `chrome/paletteMatch.ts`, which `index.ts` does not re-export;
  - two new pin files and the changeset (`patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`).

  `packages/components/src/ui/**` is untouched (objectui AGENTS.md #7), and so are the record search and the `?palette=1` deep link. Nothing is added to the package entry. No governed path.
- **Diff read (the seat's own):**
  - `matchesPaletteQuery(query, terms)` normalises the way cmdk does (lower case; whitespace and hyphens as a space). It accepts a word prefix of a term, or a contiguous substring from 3 characters on. Each Han, Hiragana or Katakana character starts a word. There is no typo tolerance. A blank query matches everything.
  - `CommandPalette` filters each navigation group by label and machine name, and the apps by label and name, then renders only the matches and a group only when something matched. The theme and full-search commands are matched over the values they already had.
  - No cmdk `value` changed. Every rendered entry carries the query as a contiguous run of its value, so cmdk's own scorer accepts it, and `CommandEmpty` shows exactly when nothing matched and the record search found nothing.
  - The recent-records group renders only on an empty query, and the record hits are unchanged.
- **Brief readings, measured:**
  - Zone 2 #1 is confirmed. cmdk 1.1.1's `commandScore` gives the card's false hits a non-zero score: `zzzz` on "Field Zoo", through its repeated-letter skip.
  - Zone 2 #2 is confirmed: `CommandDialog` spreads its props onto the Radix `Dialog`. Of the two routes, the palette's own matching was taken. `forceMount` was rejected, because cmdk does not count a force-mounted item, so "No results" would break. The composition route was measured and not taken.
  - Zone 2 #4 is pinned with the showcase's real CJK label "Command Center (大屏)".
- **Named behaviour changes** (in the PR body; they follow triage's matching rule, "prefix or substring scoring … for navigation entries"):
  - initials no longer match (`fz` no longer finds "Field Zoo");
  - the group's type word is not a matching term (`page` finds entries whose label or name holds "page", not every page).
- **Ruling honoured** (triage `6043346622`): "prefix or substring scoring, with a minimum score, for navigation entries" and "record search is unchanged". `?palette=1` is untouched.
- **Changeset sentences checked against the head:**
  - "An entry matches when the query, ignoring case, starts a word of its label or machine name … or, from three characters on, appears anywhere in one of them";
  - "each of their characters starts a word";
  - "Record hits are unchanged";
  - "Nothing is added to the package entry".
- **Reverse verification (dev report):**
  - Ablation through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the matcher replaced by "always matches" gives the five pins red with the card's own readings, and the two controls green. Restored with the blob equal to HEAD.
  - The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite: 1097 files, 10803 tests passed. The existing palette suites pass unchanged.
  - Real browser (Chromium, the console with the showcase's full 50-entry navigation and a stubbed record search), before and after: `zzzz` now shows "No results found."; `ingest` and `wayne` show only the record; `field` and `大屏` are unchanged.
- **Gates:** CI on `a76ebb5` (`head_sha` equals the PR head): 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, its shard template, `dependabot`), 0 failure. `Lint` and `Type Check` are success. Mergeable state `clean`.
- **Contract review:** not required (`Clause-②: no`).

Findings:
- The theme commands are matched by their English value words in every locale, so a zh viewer typing 主题 finds none of them. This predates the change and no declared contract covers it → `Acceptance notes`

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the queue, now.
